title.zh: THORChain 高管指责 Tether 暂时冻结 USDT 金库
title.en: Tether Blacklists Four THORChain Vaults Holding 1.45 Million USDT

current_state.zh: Tether 短暂黑名单并冻结 THORChain 四个 USDT 金库地址约 145 万 USDT，导致交易暂停；数小时后地址被解冻，交易恢复，双方未解释原因。
current_state.en: Tether briefly blacklisted and froze four THORChain USDT vault addresses holding about 1.45 million USDT, pausing trading; the addresses were unfrozen hours later, trading resumed, and neither side explained the action.

updates.title_zh: Tether Blacklists Four THORChain Vaults Holding 1.45 Million USDT
updates.title_en: Tether Blacklists Four THORChain Vaults Holding 1.45 Million USDT
updates.what_changed_zh: Tether 将四个持有 145 万 USDT 的 THORChain 金库列入黑名单，促使 THORChain 在未事先通知的情况下暂停 Tron 兑换和流动性提供者操作。
updates.what_changed_en: Tether blacklisted four THORChain vaults holding 1.45 million USDT, prompting THORChain to halt Tron swaps and liquidity-provider operations without prior notice.

updates.title_zh: THORChain 高管指责 Tether 暂时冻结 USDT 金库
updates.title_en: THORChain exec accuses Tether of temporarily freezing USDT vaults
updates.what_changed_zh: Tether 在数小时后解冻了此前被列入黑名单的四个 THORChain USDT 金库地址，约 145 万 USDT 被冻结后恢复，THORChain 交易随之恢复。
updates.what_changed_en: Tether unfroze the four previously blacklisted THORChain USDT vault addresses hours later, restoring access to about 1.45 million USDT and allowing THORChain trading to resume.

updates.current_state_en: Tether briefly blacklisted and froze four THORChain USDT vault addresses holding about 1.45 million USDT, pausing trading; the addresses were unfrozen hours later, trading resumed, and neither side explained the action.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Tether briefly blacklisted THORChain's USDt vault addresses — freezing about 1.45 million USDT across four wallets and pausing trading — before unfreezing them hours later with no explanation from either side.
